主要内容: On February 26, 2013, UNS Energy Corporation issued a press release announcing its earnings for the quarter and 12 months ended December 31, 2012. The report included financial results for both UNS Energy Corporation and Tucson Electric Power Company. The press release was attached as Exhibit 99.1, and additional supplemental information was also provided as Exhibits 99.2 and 99.3. The company highlighted the use of non-GAAP financial measures, such as revenues, operating expenses, operating income, and earnings (loss) per share, to evaluate its operations. These measures exclude non-recurring items, accounting changes, and reimbursed expenses. The company believes these non-GAAP measures provide useful insights to investors by removing the impact of variances in GAAP results that do not reflect fundamental changes in the company's earnings or cash flow capacity. The document is a Form 8-K filed by UNS Energy Corporation and Tucson Electric Power Company on February 26, 2013. It includes a press release, supplemental earnings information, and conference call presentation slides posted on the company's website. The report is signed by Kevin P. Larson, Senior Vice President and Principal Financial Officer, indicating the official filing of the financial information. The document aims to provide investors and analysts with non-GAAP financial measures for comparison with prior periods.
